summary: Fixed the only open finding, QA-3 (cites R9), adding the missing restart edge-case tests in src/App.layout.test.tsx. No production code changed. The first new test opens a console, confirms its shell started, unmounts App (the restart), remounts and reopens the same app, then asserts the console host is gone, the first terminal is shown, and startTerminal is not called again: the console is session-only, so its process is not restarted and its old scrollback is not restored. The second new test opens a dialog (Help), the branch menu, the theme finder, the app edit form and a transient update-check banner in one session, unmounts, remounts and reopens the app, then asserts none of them is reopened: transient UI is React state only and is never persisted as layout. npx vitest run src/App.layout.test.tsx (12 passed) and npm run lint both pass.
